summary: DOM event handling improved around text input, clipboard operations, drag-and-drop, SVG, and IME composition. Users can now use Accel+Shift+V to paste without formatting in text fields, while DataTransfer handles that clipboard format consistently and can access raw data when appropriate. EditContext reports selection and character bounds more completely, composition is finalized safely when edited nodes disappear, and event code now obtains the correct security principal for remote drag content.
